item.tib: zhi khro dgongs pa kun 'dus thos chog rang grol chen mo'i rgyud las skong bshags nyon mongs rang grol
item.coloph: ces zhi khro bar do thos grol gyis (gyi) skong bshags nyon mongs rang grol 'di ni/ kho bo kun grol grags pa 'ja' tshon snying po can gyis/ zhing skyong mi yi dbang po rab brtan rgyal po'i pho brang du bkod pa dge legs 'phel rgyas shog/
